verse.verse_1: Nay! I swear by this city;
verse.verse_2: And you are free in this city.
verse.verse_3: And by the begetter and that which he begot.
verse.verse_4: Verily, We have created man in Kabad.
verse.verse_5: Does he think that none can overcome him
verse.verse_6: He says: "I have wasted wealth in abundance!"
verse.verse_7: Does he think that none sees him
verse.verse_8: Have We not made for him two eyes
verse.verse_9: And a tongue and two lips
verse.verse_10: And shown him the two ways
verse.verse_11: But he has not attempted to pass on the path that is steep.
verse.verse_12: And what will make you know the path that is steep
verse.verse_14: Or giving food in a day full of Masghabah,
verse.verse_15: To an orphan near of kin.
verse.verse_16: Or to a Miskin cleaving to dust.
verse.verse_17: Then he became one of those who believed and recommended one another to patience, and recommended one another to compassion.
verse.verse_18: They are those on the Right,
verse.verse_19: But those who disbelieved in Our Ayat, they are those on the Left.
